OpenAI-compatible Whisper speech-to-text on the CachyOS (x86_64_v3) base.
The candy is the only thing this image exists to run — no dbus, no charly CLI —
so the image is layer-whisper on the CachyOS base and nothing else. The model
cache is a host bind (the shared store) and the candy pins HOME to the image
user's home so a bound deployment uses it.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-whisper:v2026.325.1751`
- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-supervisord:v2026.330.2000`
